text:
Jordan: noticed something odd in console preview — some previews show resources from a different tenant when I switch orgs :eyes:
Sasha: ugh. can you repro and paste traces?
Jordan: steps: open /runs list, switch workspace via top-left, open side preview. payload has runs from org 'org-alpha' while my header says 'org-beta'
Jordan: network snippet:
Jordan: ```
GET /console/prefetch?route=/runs 200 OK
x-tenant-id: org-beta
cache-key: prefetch:v2:route=/runs:tenant=undefined
body: [{"run":{"org":"org-alpha","id":420}}, ... ]
```
Anh: looks like cache key generation missed the tenant header in the server-side prefetch path after the v2 middleware refactor
Mike: which deploy did we ship with the refactor?
deploy-bot: deployed console-service@0.23.1 (canary 15%) at 1732464000
Sasha: that aligns. v2 route-affinity middleware switched from reading `req.headers['x-tenant-id']` to `req.locals.tenant` and not all prefetch paths set locals on SSR requests
Jordan: impact: cross-tenant preview exposure in the UI for a subset of users hitting cached prefetch responses. telemetry shows a small but real spike in org-mismatch alerts
ops-bot: alert: console.prefetch.cross_tenant_preview +42 (now 58) — investigation ongoing
Anh: short-term mitigation: when composing cache key, include both header and locals fallback and write dual entries so reads succeed against either variant. also purge suspect keys for last 48h
Sasha: agree. we'll need to be careful with eviction to avoid huge cache churn. dual-write avoids immediate invalidation and is rollback-safe
Mike: plan: PR to add dual-key write + read-fallback, add test for server SSR path, then roll to 30% and watch ops-bot. revert if mismatch alerts >5 per 15m window.
Jordan: created INF-3499 with checklist: patch, audit other prefetch endpoints (artifacts, logs, runs), eviction script, notify trust/legal, postmortem note
Sasha: drafting PR now. implementation detail: cacheKey = `prefetch:v2:route=${route}:tenant=${tenant||'__MISSING__'}`; when storing, also write `tenant=__MISSING__` variant if tenant missing; on read prefer concrete tenant then fallback to __MISSING__
Anh: I'll scan the repo for other places where `req.locals` was introduced without header fallbacks — running grep for `req.locals.tenant` and `prefetch:` keys
Mike: I'll coordinate support/trust comms. trust-team: heads up, we may need to reach out to a few customers about preview exposure, but it's limited surface. legal: looped for FYI
trust: copy, prepping customer outreach draft
legal: thanks — keep logs of affected org ids and timeframe so we can assess impact
Jordan: also adding telemetry gating to ops-bot so future canary rolls alert on org mismatch earlier
Sasha: PR up as draft in review, adding unit + integration tests. will include a feature flag to toggle dual-key behavior for safe rollback
Mike: after merge: bump canary to 30% then 60% over 2 hours if no ops spikes. will run eviction script during low traffic window
Jordan: thanks all. follow-ups: postmortem + tighten rollout checks in console rollouts UX so prefetch key changes require explicit opt-in
Anh: running audit now and will post results to INF-3499
Jordan: :thumbsup:
